scenarioPlan.name: Draft create and reload
prerequisites: Authorized user with Sales Orders access
expectedUi: Select the linked customer and product in the Sales Order form
Save the draft and reopen it after a browser reload
expectedEffects: One draft with the selected customer and one line is persisted
No payment transaction or inventory movement is created
assertions: Order, line quantity, total, customer, and product match the prepared dimensions
Inventory and payment baselines are unchanged
cleanupRequirements: Delete run-owned draft orders through the Atlas order service and verify their soft-delete state in Supabase.
Delete only the run-owned product and customer after dependent orders are cleaned.
Retire storage only when this run created it, ownership is proven, and no active products depend on it.
